audit.title: Lead-to-Order Lifecycle Audit & Bug Analysis Report

bugs.symptom: Statuses can move backward arbitrarily and skip transitions.
bugs.root_cause: Workflow transition check falls back to searching for any transition with matching action name, ignoring fromStateId. Hardcoded map also directly changes states without transition verification.

bugs.symptom: Parallel clicks or requests create duplicate Sales Orders for the same quotation.
bugs.root_cause: Unique database constraint is placed on quotationId, but conversion only populates sourceQuotationId. Lacks locking or transaction checks preventing concurrent double creation.

bugs.symptom: QC pass on production floor updates FinishedGoods but logs no stock IN transaction. QC approve on QC portal logs stock IN transaction but registers no FinishedGoods.
bugs.root_cause: Two separate competing QC endpoints exist, each performing only half of the required inventory actions and updating different status fields.

bugs.symptom: Unable to request returns or replacements for dispatches marked as POD_RECEIVED or DISPATCH_CLOSED.
bugs.root_cause: Validation logic only checks dispatches in DELIVERED or COMPLETED statuses, returning 0 delivered quantity for dispatches in POD_RECEIVED or DISPATCH_CLOSED.

bugs.symptom: Leads and samples controllers can be accessed and modified publicly without authentication.
bugs.root_cause: @Public() decorator applied at class level of controllers, disabling JwtAuthGuard and PermissionsGuard.

bugs.symptom: Duplicate production plans can be generated for the same Sales Order.
bugs.root_cause: Manual createPlan service method does not verify if a production plan already exists for the Sales Order. Database schema lacks unique constraint.

bugs.symptom: Generate Quotation button does not disappear after quotation is created.
bugs.root_cause: Frontend looks up quotation.status which is undefined because Quotation database model lacks a status field and backend doesn't map it. Zustand store also becomes stale due to page refreshes and direct API calls bypass.

missing.key: sourceQuotationId should be unique or controlled via strict lock
salesOrderItemId should be unique or split batches explicitly tracked
